source_precedence: WooCommerce explicit product fields and attributes
manufacturer/supplier datasheet or catalog with identifiable product match
real product label/packaging/photo with readable identifying data
existing product title/description as candidate-only evidence
inference from similar products is forbidden

identifier_policy.sku: Existing non-empty unique Woo SKU is accepted as stable shop identifier.
identifier_policy.gtin: Never generate or infer. Requires real manufacturer/supplier/packaging evidence.
identifier_policy.mpn: Never generate or infer. Requires real manufacturer/supplier/packaging evidence.
identifier_policy.brand: Use explicit Woo brand/attribute or verified supplier/manufacturer evidence only.

compatibility_policy.rule: Nominal size alone never proves compatibility.
compatibility_policy.edge_rule: A compatibility edge is verified only when explicit evidence supports the required interface fields.
compatibility_policy.title_size_tokens: candidate-only; never published as compatibility proof

media_policy: AI imagery may be illustrative but cannot satisfy the real-product evidence/image requirement.
decision_template_policy: Decision links and cautions may be added without inventing specs. Missing technical data must remain visibly unknown.
acceptance: Internal Phase 3 implementation can pass while supplier/customer evidence gates remain blocked; external evidence must never be fabricated to force a green score.
